free_tier.stated: Free, USD 0, Free Forever: 300 minutes of testing, with up to 2 concurrent sessions on Windows or Linux VMs; 100 accessibility tests per organisation. The 100 minutes of Automation testing are a separate one-time allowance, valid for lifetime.
free_tier.notes: The free HyperExecute minutes renew monthly and cap concurrency at 2 sessions; the free Automation allowance of 100 minutes is one-time and does not renew.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a browser or VM test session, not a stored object
per_object_cap.notes: A paid Test Manager plan states 10 GB of data storage per user; no per-object cap is published.

retention.stated: 30-day data retention on the testing plans; the paid plans offer custom data retention rules at Enterprise, and the free Smart UI tier states 1 month of build history.
retention.notes: The 30-day retention is stated on the Live Testing and paid Automation plans on the vendor's own pricing.md page.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress allowance, price or transfer quota for test results or artifacts is published on the pricing page read; the plan pages describe test minutes and parallel sessions, not network egress.

interface_detail: RESTful APIs for automating pipelines and screenshot APIs; Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Puppeteer and Appium drive the grid; the Kane CLI and Rook CLI install from npm.
tooling: Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer, Appium, TestNG, WebdriverIO; free npm CLIs @testmuai/kane-cli and @testmuai/rook; REST APIs and CI integrations with GitHub, GitLab and CircleCI.
chaining: The free HyperExecute cloud runs browser and VM test sessions that compose with CI pipelines and object-storage records for logs and artifacts; the paid Automation and Real Device plans extend the same grid to mobile devices.

limits.value: 300 minutes of free test execution per month, up to 2 concurrent Windows or Linux VM sessions
1 parallel test on the free plan; a parallel session is one test executing at a time
30-day data retention on the paid non-enterprise plans
100 minutes of web+mobile automation testing, one-time, valid for lifetime, with 2 parallel sessions

limits_note: A free HyperExecute run is 300 minutes a month at 2 concurrent sessions; the Automation free tier is 100 minutes once, not a monthly refill. Lower tiers cap parallelism at 1 and exclude CI/CD integrations and auto-heal.
binding_note: The 300 monthly minutes at 2 concurrent sessions are what run out first for a recurring free workload; the 100 Automation minutes are one-time and the concurrency is capped at 2 sessions.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers Continue with Google, Continue with Github, or Work email, then Continue; no card, phone or ID document is asked on that page, and the pricing FAQ states the free tier needs no credit card.

reliability_note: Free Automation minutes are one-time and do not renew; free live sessions are limited to 2 minutes each and renew monthly; free tiers exclude CI/CD integrations, auto-heal, AI RCA and scheduled workflows; data retention on Live and paid plans is 30 days.
confidence_note: The published rates, free minutes, concurrency caps, sign-up fields and retention line are quoted from the vendor's pricing page and pricing.md read on 2026-11-24; no egress price is published there.

notes: TestMu AI is the former LambdaTest, rebranded on 2026-01-12. The free capacity is time-boxed: HyperExecute gives 300 minutes a month at 2 concurrent sessions and Automation gives 100 minutes once. The Automation, Live, HyperExecute, SmartUI, Performance Testing and Test Manager free tiers are separate pools; the page does not say whether bundled allowances add to a product's own free minutes, so they are not summed.
